# Format options

The template sets these Quarto options. Override any of them in your document or `_quarto.yml`.

## Layout

| Option | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `toc-depth` | 3 |
| `page-layout` | article |
| `code-fold` | show |
| `html-math-method` | katex |

## Type

| Option | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `mainfont` | Geist |
| `monofont` | Geist Mono |
| `fontsize` | 16.5px |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| <kbd>C</kbd> | Collapse or expand all code |
| <kbd>D</kbd> | Toggle dark and light theme |
| <kbd>T</kbd> | Show or hide the contents |
| <kbd>F</kbd> | Fold the section under the cursor |
